source_caveat: The derivative example is Figure S16 on SI PDF p.20; Table S3a–d occupies pp.21–24. Coordinate blocks are pp.18–19. The p.19 heading repeats Ih, but its distinct 80-carbon cage graph has 20 automorphisms while p.18 has120; both are cubic connected graphs and both public coordinate arrays match their source blocks exactly. Thus the inherited D5h label is supported by topology rather than the duplicated heading.
